text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hello, coming in! Trainer, we're having a 
Christmas party!

Having said her piece out of nowhere, 
Mejiro Palmer walked right into the room 
without hesitation. Right behind her, Nice 
Nature and the others filed in as well.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to spring this on you so suddenly, 
but I ended up planning a Christmas party 
with Palmer and the others.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Would you like to join us too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It'd really help out if you could let us 
use this place while we're here!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oops, Trainer looks completely blank.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Um, actually, you see...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Your family isn't having a Christmas 
party, Sato-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Both my father and mother are busy 
working and doing charity work on 
Christmas.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
While I occasionally attend business 
parties with Father or host group 
gatherings at our estate...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We don't really have parties with just the 
family.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Fo' real? No presents is such a bummer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I did receive my present! Santa Claus 
put it in my stocking during the night!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
However, I've never experienced a 
Christmas home party like the ones in the 
movies... I do long for it a little.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. While it may be difficult to 
invite Satono-san's parents, we can still 
host a house party ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
We're super used to cozy house parties 
anyway. Let's do this thing!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yay! Party, party!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, even if your parents can't make it, 
wouldn't we be able to invite Sato-chan's 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Tannhauser, you're a genius! Alright, see 
ya there for now!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
“—And that is why we are here. Would you 
kindly grant us permission to use the 
venue and join us for the event?”

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Whoa, really!? Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's get right to decorating.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Phew, that should about do it, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Amazing... That's wonderful! Even though 
the decorations are handmade, they turned 
out so lovely...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm ho~me! I bought lots of food and 
sweets!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Chicken and pizza☆ Woohoo!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Good evening!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh, Kita-chan?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, we met at the school gate earlier, 
and I got invited too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You're more than welcome! Come on in, 
Kita-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I mean, this group is the exact same as 
the one from the freshman welcome party!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It really brings back memories, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hauwaa~... To think that the freshman back 
then has grown up to be so magnificent...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, alright, we can catch up later! 
Let's eat before the food gets cold!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Pizza, salad, chicken... Dried squid, 
stingray fin, pickled kelp...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I see, so this is what a typical home 
party menu looks like.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I want to say, "That's not true..." but 
our family Christmas table is packed with 
bar snacks too, so I can't even deny 
it...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, the folks from the shopping street 
gave me all sorts of things~. Looks like 
there's cheap candy and snacks mixed in 
too. I'm so grateful~.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Finished! Now then, last place will be 
either Kita-chan or Turbo-san!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Maybe I'll go with the one on the 
far right...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Right on the far left, as expected...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yep, I'll go with the far left!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
No no no nooo!! I won't let you pick the 
left one!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Turbo, just give it up. You're way too 
easy to read, honestly...

And so, a wonderful time drew to an end... 
The Christmas party came to a close.

I walk Satono Diamond and Kitasan Black 
back to the dorms after they stayed until 
the very end to help clean up.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, today was lots of fun!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Christmas has always had the image of just 
another work day to me, so...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I see, Dia-chan did say she goes out every 
year for Christmas, after all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Next time, I want to invite my 
little brother too.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're right! They'll definitely be 
thrilled! Let's throw a party next year 
too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Next year... will you participate too, 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Really? That's a promise, okay?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I've already made the reservation. So 
don't you dare go making other plans, 
okay?"

"Onto next year's still-blank calendar, a 
single promise was added: to spend 
Christmas with Satono Diamond."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Well then, time for the cake—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ah!? The cake... I forgot to buy it!!

I set out with Satono Diamond to buy cake. 
However, the nearby shops were sold out, 
so we ended up traveling a bit farther.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The illuminations are beautiful, aren't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, walking through the city at 
Christmas like this is something I've 
longed to do ever since seeing it in 
movies.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's not that I'm dissatisfied with 
the work and charity events with Father 
and the others, you know?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It has been an invaluable learning 
experience, and I take great pride in 
being able to assist.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I just thought... something like this 
would be nice, too...
choice_data_list: Shall we take a slow walk?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Still... everyone is waiting for their 
cake, so...
choice_data_list: I'm fine, there were plenty of snacks.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, that's true. There was so much we 
could barely finish it all!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, shall we take our time?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The town streets during Christmas feel 
kind of like a foreign country, don't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It reminds me of the streets I walked 
during a trip abroad a long time ago.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, I'd... love to walk through 
foreign streets with you sometime."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: What about you, Trainer-san?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
When you agreed to be my trainer, it was 
kind of because I forced your hand.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That is why, this time, I want to properly 
hear what your intentions are, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Will you come overseas with me?
choice_data_list: If that's what you want, I'll go.
If that's what you want, I'll go.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness! Trainer, I look forward to 
continuing to work with you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Let's walk through the streets of foreign 
cities together again!

Looking at the exotic, Christmas-lit 
cityscape, I made a promise with Satono 
Diamond about our not-so-distant future.
